entities.summary: Zunaid Ahmed Palak is an Awami League politician. He is a former Minister of State for Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology, and was a member of the Jatiya Sangsad from the constituency of Natore-3. He reportedly admitted enforcing a nationwide internet shutdown during the July–August student protests of 2024. He is currently imprisoned on charges of abetting massacre, crimes against humanity and murder during the student protests.
